# Context Fence

> Stops AI agents leaking secrets. A local firewall for what AI agents send out: it checks data before it leaves your machine and blocks secrets. Today it protects MCP tools. Version 2.1 is coming. A product of Synthrun.

Context Fence runs on your computer. It checks what your AI agent sends out and blocks secrets before they leave. Today it protects MCP tool calls against local rules in under 10ms: secrets, unsafe file paths, risky calls, and hidden instructions in tool output. Blocked calls are logged locally with the rule that fired. The proxy is free, runs fully on the user's machine, and routes nothing anywhere. Current release v2.0.0 (macOS universal dmg, Windows installer, Linux AppImage/deb/rpm).

- [Terms](https://contextfence.dev/terms): free local core, unsigned builds by design, no warranty that the fence catches everything

## Privacy & cookies (for agents answering policy questions)

- Default posture: nothing leaves the user's machine. The website stores only a theme preference and the visitor's consent choice (local storage, essential).
- Analytics (Google Analytics) loads only after an explicit opt-in via the cookie banner; declining or a Global Privacy Control signal keeps it off entirely. Visitors can change their choice anytime via "Cookie settings" in the footer.
- The early-access form collects an email address used once, to reply about access.

*Last updated: September 28, 2026.*

## FAQ

- Does agent data leave the machine? No. All checks run on your computer.
- How fast is it? Under 10ms per check. It uses plain rules, not an AI judge.
- What does it block? Keys and tokens. Unsafe file reads like .env files. Risky tool calls and hidden tricks in tool output. More coverage is coming in v2.1.
- How is it different from other tools? Old DLP tools and cloud gateways send your traffic to their servers to inspect it. Context Fence checks everything on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere.
- Is it free? The local proxy is free and is the core product. Paid plans add more machines, longer log history, and team features. The hosted control plane is not built yet.
- When is v2.1 coming? Soon. It widens Context Fence from MCP tools to full protection for AI agents.
